### The Bible Always Survives and Always Will
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-february-7-2017.html
Passage: Matthew 24:35
Points:
- Despite relentless criticism, denial, and attempts at suppression throughout history, Scripture consistently outlasts every opponent.
- The Bible remains the most widely read and translated book in the world, continually transforming lives across cultures.
- Jesus taught that while the physical universe will perish, God's truth is eternal and cannot be destroyed.
- Earthly skeptics and their philosophies fade into obscurity, but the promises of Scripture remain steadfast.
- Believers can anchor their lives in full confidence upon the unfailing permanence of God's Word.

### Within a Generation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/within-generation
Passage: Mark 13:27-31
Points:
- Apocalyptic biblical imagery often portrays dramatic historical shifts and divine judgment rather than the cosmic end of history.
- Jesus used the fig tree illustration to urge His disciples to perceive the impending judgment coming upon Jerusalem.
- The destruction of Jerusalem and the temple in AD 70 precisely fulfilled Christ's prophetic timeline within that generation.
- The accuracy of these historical events proves that Jesus' words are more solid, dependable, and enduring than creation itself.
- Following the fall of Jerusalem, the gospel advanced across the earth to gather God's people from every nation.
